text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky has left an incredible mark on
the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She stood fast in this competitive and
unrelenting
world of racing alongside
her trainer, and now...
Cast! ...Plop.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
After her dream to savor the slow, good
ol' life of
retirement came true...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She lived happily ever after. Dun-dun! ♪

Our first three years together are over.
Sure,
we've reached an ending of sorts,
but she has to
keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Shh! Quiet. You're gonna scare the fish.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you came all the way here. Give
in to the
moment—relax and grab a rod.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: We've worked hard for three whole years. I deserve a break today.

Sky seems pretty serious. She says
"today," but I
can't help feeling she'll
skip practice much longer
than that.

After all this time together, I know
exactly how to
light a fire under her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Mmm, this weather's perfect...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. That sounded way too forced.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see right through your little act. You
think you
can lure me in with—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Undisputed?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...No no, that's got nothing to do with
me
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm over being exhausted and tired of
planning
strategies.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, fishin's gonna pay my
bills.
Yessiree, that's what I'm—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Dominate.

For a moment, Sky closes her eyes and
listens to
the murmurs of the stream.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyone ever told ya you're a complete
nutcase,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tryin' to bait a racer past their heyday
back onto
the track...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Dominate"... Hmph... I'd love to make
'em eat
those words.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Okey dokey. Guess it's time to move
out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Geez. You're really gonna play dumb, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on. The fish aren't really biting
over here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Why stick around if there's nothing to
catch?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of somewhere greener, a
place where
I can move my legs a bit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's focus on our next big
catch, and...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Start our strategy meeting! ♪
